name: high-acu
title: A Serve Aurora instance has sustained high ACU usage
description: An Aurora instance has had average ACU utilisation at or above 85% for 45 minutes.
investigation_steps: Check the affected database instance and its ACU metrics. Could the high ACU usage be related to recent deployments or expected load?
Review database connections, query activity and Performance Insights. Is this indicative of a query or connection issue causing the high ACU usage?
Is this causing production service degradation or unavailability? If so, an incident will most likely need to be raised.
